title: Send this to your brother (Bhaubeej)
caption:
Send this to your brother. He has never once guessed right.

The Duo Link Bracelet: gold-tone and silver-tone links, joined by small stacked gold-tone rings. Two tones, a little like the two of you. ₹999.

Bhaubeej is next week. Forward accordingly.

[ duo link bracelet · two tone · forwarded, not hinted ]
first_comment:
Tag the brother who has never once guessed right.
#NairaFlore #NairaPetite #Bhaubeej #BhaiDooj #GiftsForHer
alt_text: A deep red tile. Near the top, a bracelet of long oval links, alternately gold-tone and silver-tone, joined by small gold-tone rings, lies on two pinked swatches, gold-coloured and silver-grey, overlapping and tacked together with a cream running stitch. Below it, large cream capitals read: Send this to your brother. Then, in blush italics: he has never once guessed right. A thin gold-coloured thread runs from the bracelet's extender down to an ivory tag whose window is half gold-coloured, half silver-grey, reading Shade N° 04, matched to the two of you, two tones, joined. Small type at the top reads: The Match, N° 04, Bhaubeej. At the bottom: Duo Link Bracelet, ₹999.
deviations: Cut-out: duo-link-bracelet/01-trim.png (the flat lay, 933x665) instead of 00-trim.png. Checked at 100% on red room and lac, 00 holds cream plaster inside the lobster clasp and between the extender links, and it is shot at an angle with the extender out of focus. 01 has the whole piece in focus and lies flat, which is how a piece rests on a swatch. Its own matte also held plaster in the extender until it was re-matted on 25 Oct (see checks). The spec's width (520px, 56% of native, so never upscaled), centre x390 and rotation -6deg are kept. At the native ratio it is 371px tall (00 would be 319), and it spans x112-668, y763-1185 including the extender. In this photo the seven links alternate gold-tone and silver-tone.

Thread anchor: (624,360), the extender's last ring (the same ring as before, (624,864), moved up 504 with the piece), instead of the spec's 'about (640,930)'. In 01 the bracelet's right end is the extender, and a shop tag is tied there. Path M904 1073 Q764 1103 624 360, per the emblem formula; its curve passes right of 'SEND THIS' (x~738 at y831; the line's ink ends at x637).

Skeleton A -> B (grid-director fix 9, 26 Oct): P4 repeated the headline-top-left skeleton of P5 beside it and P7 above it. The swatch goes to the top, data-y 190 (x90, 600x560, rot 3 unchanged), the cut-out to centre (390,470) (was 974), the thread to (624,360). Headline baselines b880 / b992 / b1104 (were b296 / b408 / b520), turn b1188 (was b604); 'DUO LINK BRACELET · ₹999' stays at b1360. The swatch's raised top-left corner (rotated) sits at y~175, 63px under the eyebrow's baseline (the fix asked 55). Superseded: the 14px drop of the 25 Oct pass.

Swatch halves reversed from the spec (art director fix, 25 Oct). The spec put gold zari upper right and silver tone lower left. It is now gold zari lower left and silver tone upper right (data-fill #C99A4C, data-fill2 #C9C6C8), so the 2px gold thread, the lobster clasp and the extender read against silver instead of sinking into gold, and two of the three silver links sit on gold. On the old order the thread vanished on the zari from the last extender ring (624,864) to the swatch edge near (688,950), and at feed size the tag looked tied to the cloth, not the bracelet. Size, position, +3deg rotation, stitch, sheen and texture are unchanged. The tag chip (gold left, silver right) now mirrors the swatch.

Swatch texture (grid-director fix 5, 26 Oct): both halves are mid-tone fills (zari #C99A4C luminance .36, silver #C9C6C8 .57), so each takes AI-1 relief soft-light .55 plus AI-1 silk multiply .18 at seed + 7, and the gold half reads as zari silk rather than flat painted card. The relief keeps the mean colour (README deviation 4). Fix 4: the swatch is 600 wide, so its sheen is the two soft bands, not the 120deg stripe. Measured on the export away from the piece: gold half about (201,158,89) against chip #C99A4C (201,154,76), silver half about (197,194,195) against #C9C6C8 (201,198,200), sampled clear of the piece. Superseded: the light-fill rule (AI-1 multiply .30) of the 25 Oct pass.
Alt text corrected to match the render. The turn is set in blush italics, not cream. Added the swatch's stitch, the thread, the tag's split chip and detail line, the eyebrow and the footer price.

ECD pass (26 Oct). The diagonal-split swatch (retired on covers, SF3: at grid size the gold/silver triangle read as a flag) is two swatches tacked together: gold tissue #C99A4C under (x80 y250 430x500, -5deg, seed 21) and silver tissue #C9C6C8 over (x300 y185 430x500, 6deg, seed 22, data-tack="left", the cream running stitch 14px inside its left edge). The bracelet, the thread and the tag are unchanged; the extender now lies on silver. The gold swatch's lowest corner is at ~y768, 25px over the SEND THIS cap tops (~y793). Footer: a-foot 20px .28em b1352 with the price in an a-price span (SF1; was 22px .24em b1360). Alt text updated; caption unchanged.

Grid-remaining pass (26 Oct, system only): SF1 maker's mark (system, 26 Oct): every non-mini tag now carries the flower as a crisp 18x26 blush mark at (111,286) in the tag's lower third, 8px above the inner gold rule, instead of the 62x90 ghost at 12% behind the second name line and the detail (read as a pink smudge at 100%). Nothing else changed.
checks: Price ₹999 matches research/roster.json and research/data/shopify-live-2026-10-25.json today (25 Oct 2026): stock 20, gift_friendly true, not pre-order, needs_size false, Edition Two, tags Two Tone / Waterproof / Tarnish Free / Hypoallergenic. The compare-at ₹1,900 is not shown. The repo snapshot still says ₹1,299 (the 21 Oct price), so it was not used. Re-read Shopify the morning of 3 Nov and the evening before; if the price moves, change the footer and the caption together.

Claims: the image carries no metal word and no water, tarnish or allergy claim. Tag detail 'two tones, joined' and the caption's 'gold-tone and silver-tone links, joined by small stacked gold-tone rings' match the listing: 'long oval links in gold tone and rhodium coated ... joined by small stacked gold rings', with the rings given as gold-tone, never bare gold. 'Bhaubeej is next week' is true on Tue 3 Nov (Bhai Dooj Wed 11 Nov per the brief, Drik). No date or delivery promise on the image or in the caption.

Copy: no em dashes, exclamation marks, emoji, urgency, codes or percentages on the image or in the caption. The one price on the image is in Jost 500 with Poppins for ₹. Velista has ligatures off (font-variant-ligatures: none) and carries no ₹, middot or accented letter. Spellings match the spec: BHAUBEEJ, N° 04, THE TWO / OF YOU. No non-Latin script on this tile.

Type positions (26 Oct, skeleton B): eyebrow b112, SEND THIS b880, TO YOUR b992, BROTHER. b1104, turn b1188, footer b1360 (a-b places each on its baseline within Chromium's pixel snapping). Headline ink spans x72-645 and the turn x72-649. No overlaps, no clipped glyphs, one line each, no widows. Tag name 'THE TWO' 160px and 'OF YOU' 132px, both under 204, so 36px at b170/b206; detail on one line at b250.

Contrast (WCAG) on red room #4B191A, then on the grained ground as rendered (79,31,31): headline cream 12.7 / 11.9, turn blush-mid 10.0 / 9.4, eyebrow and footer kicker 10.5 / 9.8. On the tag paper: warm grey 5.4, ink 16.4, ink-soft 10.9.

Safe areas: all content within y90-1382 (eyebrow cap top 90, tag's rotated corner 1382). The top-right x>=907, y<=202 is empty ground (the swatch's top-right corner is at x~690). Only the tag (box 753-1027 x 1028-1382, hole (904,1073)) and the thread enter x>=740 & y>=1010 (checked with body.a-guides). The 4:5 crop keeps every element, with the tag 13px above its bottom edge.

Cut-out: 01-trim shown at 520x371 against a native 933x665, so it is never upscaled. Matte cleaned 25 Oct. The old matte was a hard binary mask that kept beige plaster webbing in the wedges where the curb links overlap: along both strands of the extender (in 01-trim pixels about x600-885, y45-185, worst at (607-627,53-67), (637-687,127-150) and (817-877,127-180)), at the junction by the lobster clasp's jump ring, inside the extender's end ring, and as a cream strip along the right outer edge of the big gold link below the extender (about x780-795, y190-250). Fix: the extender area was re-matted from the full-resolution Shopify original (1856x2304, 1.65x the matte's source), cropped so BiRefNet saw each link about 2.7x larger than in the 01 matte, with a soft mask. The result was mapped back to the 01-trim grid and used only for x>=548, y<=292, feathered 14px into the old matte, and allowed to add nothing beyond 2px from the old silhouette. 1,323 pixels went to alpha 0 and 4,432 edge pixels are now antialiased. Every pixel that stays fully opaque keeps its original RGB bit for bit (103,233 px), so the metal colour is untouched. Only pixels whose alpha changed carry a foreground colour estimate (pymatting ML), so no plaster tint is left in the fringe. Nothing outside that area changed. 01.png got the same pixels at its offset (138,375), and _system/cutouts.js was regenerated for this entry only: bbox [12,12,922,653], the hull moved only along the top of the extender, so the contact shadow is unchanged. Checked at 300% on lac and red room (_work/matte-extender-300-lac-before-after.png, _work/matte-extender-300-redroom-before-after.png, _work/matte-lac.png, _work/matte-redroom.png): every link gap is open, the wire is intact, no grey film, no seam at the feather. The rest of the piece keeps its original hard edge, which the 0.56x display scale smooths. The kit drop shadow plus the system contact shadow (395x14, 30% black, blur 10, 6px under the lowest link) sit on the gold half.

Swatch: 600x560, pinked on all four edges, rotated +3deg about its centre, split along its top-left to bottom-right diagonal. Lower-left is gold zari #C99A4C, upper-right is silver tone #C9C6C8 (reversed from the spec, see deviations), with a 2px cream #F6EFE6 running stitch (10 on / 8 off) on the diagonal and the system's two soft sheen bands (it is over 400 px wide). Tag chip split vertically, #C99A4C left and #C9C6C8 right, all colours the system's.

Thumb (391x521, 26 Oct): the swatch and bracelet read at the top, SEND THIS / TO YOUR / BROTHER. at about 30px cap height below, the turn legible; the bracelet's alternating tones read on the two halves, the gold half now shows its silk. The thread runs from the extender's last ring (624,360) down past the headline's right edge into the tag's hole.

Grid check (_grid.png, rebuilt 26 Oct with all twelve current covers): P4 sits at r3c3 as skeleton B (picture on top, headline lower-left), so r3 reads B-A-B and column 3 B-A-B-S; P4 no longer repeats P5 or P7. The N° 04 tag lands in the same corner and at the same angle as the other eight.

Not changed, flagged to the system owner (AD note 6, not blocking): on two-line tag names the 12% blush ghost flower (tag y155-245) sits behind the second line. Here it shows as a faint pink shape between OF and YOU at 100%, and it cannot be seen in the thumb. The fix the AD proposes (ghost lower on two-line tags, e.g. y185-275, or 8% opacity) belongs in _system and must land on all nine covers at once, so it is left for that decision rather than changed on P4 alone.

Grid-director pass (26 Oct): s01 re-rendered (render.cjs + export.py), viewed at full size, with body.a-guides (_work/s01-guides.html) and as the thumb. render.cjs: missingImages [], fontsNotLoaded [].

Grid-remaining pass (26 Oct): s01 re-rendered and viewed at full size and as the thumb; render.cjs missingImages [], fontsNotLoaded []. check.cjs: 708px of thread outside the tag; hero duo-link-bracelet, no edge-adjacent repeat. _grid.png rebuilt.
